title: Meter Operations Standard: Submetered Reads, Usage Lines and Estimated Reads
content:
# Submetered Reads and Usage Lines — Utility Services Program

## Clauses in force

**S1. When usage lines post.** Usage lines post only while the account is active or in final billing. The account's status is read from the system record of that account.

**S2. Read schedule.** Each metered service covered by the program is read on the last day of every billing period (a calendar month), on the service start date and on the service end date. The service start read only opens the meter and bills nothing, and the service end read closes the final period in place of a period-end read.

**S3. Sewer.** Sewer is billed as a separate line on the metered water usage at the program's sewer rate plus its monthly fixed sewer service charge when the program's sewer usage is measured by metered water usage.

**S4. Limit on consecutive estimates.** No more than the program's maximum number of consecutive estimated reads may be billed, after which the next period waits for an actual read. The consecutive estimates of a service are counted back from the period in question: they are the estimated reads of that service immediately before the period, up to the first actual read.

**S5. Over-billed estimates.** When, at the first actual read after estimates, the actual cumulative usage since the last actual read less the usage already billed on the estimates is negative, the over-billed amount is credited by an estimated-read true-up adjustment.

**S6. Issue day.** Lines of the previous month are issued on the program's bill issue day.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this standard have been superseded and are **no longer in force**:

1. The clause that the usage line for a period bills the usage times the service rate (water per thousand gallons, gas per therm or electricity per kilowatt-hour) plus the service's fixed monthly charge prorated by days of responsibility, rounded half up to the cent.
2. The clause that, when an actual read cannot be obtained, the usage is estimated as the average usage of the service's most recent actual reads, prorated by days, and the line is marked estimated.
3. The clause that, when the program trues up on the actual read, the first actual read after estimates bills the actual cumulative usage since the last actual read less the usage already billed on the estimates.

## Consecutive-estimate check (Clause S4)

| Reads immediately before the period, most recent first | Consecutive estimates counted |
|---|---|
| actual | 0 |
| estimated, then actual | 1 |
| estimated, estimated, then actual | 2 |

*Example (hypothetical program with a maximum of two):* when the two reads immediately before a period are both estimates, the count is two and the next period waits for an actual read.

superseded_clauses: The usage line for a period bills usage_quantity times the service rate (water_rate_per_kgal, gas_rate_per_therm or electric_rate_per_kwh) plus the service's fixed monthly charge prorated by days of responsibility, rounded half up to the cent;
When an actual read cannot be obtained the usage is estimated as utility_msr_average_usage, prorated by days, and the line is marked estimated;
When true_up_on_actual_read is true, the first actual read after estimates bills the actual cumulative usage since the last actual read less the usage already billed on the estimates;
